offline: You're offline. What you typed is kept; try again when you're back online.
badResponse: The server's answer was incomplete. Try again.
rateLimited: Too many requests. Try again in {{seconds}} seconds.
notFound: Not found. It may have been deleted or passed its retention period.
visitClosed: This previsit has been sent and can't be changed.
busy: Still working on your last action. Please wait a moment.
stale: This was just updated. The latest version is loaded; check it and send again.
unauthorized: Your session has ended. Sign in again.
tooLarge: That's too long. Shorten it and send again.
invalidRequest: Something in the request isn't valid. Check it and try again.
invalidState: That isn't possible in the current state. Refresh and look again.
internal: Something went wrong on our side. Try again later.

run.budget: Today's AI limit is used up. Red-flag checks and the refill check still work, and you can send your answers as they are.
run.timeout: The AI took too long to answer. Try again.
run.interrupted: Your last message wasn't finished. Try again.
run.model: The AI can't answer right now. Try again.
run.unknown: This answer wasn't finished. Try again.

field.range: That number is out of range. Please check it.
field.usernameChars: Use letters, digits and . _ - only, starting with a letter or digit.
field.passwordSame: The new password must be different from the current one.
field.bpOrder: Diastolic must be lower than systolic.
field.perFillExceedsTotal: Days per fill can't exceed the total days.
field.beforePrescription: The last fill can't be earlier than the prescription date.

leave.unsaved: You have unsaved changes that may be lost if you leave.
leave.unsent: A message hasn't been sent. It stays on this device and is sent the next time you open it.

session.expired: Your session has ended. Sign in again; unsent work is still here.
session.unreachable: Can't reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
